主要内容: Kohl's (KSS) reported Q4 2021 earnings, with sales below analysts' estimates. Net sales rose to $6.22 billion from $5.88 billion, but fell short of $6.54 billion estimates. The company plans to expand its partnership with Sephora, opening shop-in-shops at hundreds of stores. Sephora shop-in-shops showed mid-single-digit sales growth compared to the rest of its chain. Kohl's also plans to double its annual dividend and buy back at least $1 billion of its stock. CFO Jill Timm noted the company's outlook assumes strengthening in the coming months despite macro challenges. Sephora will be a key growth driver in 2022, though margins may contract slightly due to higher freight costs and inflation.
